label_definitions.high_internal_confidence: Internally pinned or golden-parity tested, internal-only; not externally validated.
label_definitions.medium_internal_confidence: Internally tested, with documented evidence; not externally validated.
label_definitions.low_internal_confidence: Implemented and tested at the broadest level only; sub-areas may vary.
label_definitions.exploratory: Research-stage or pre-validation; no parity evidence.
label_definitions.not_approved: Exists in some form but not approved for any scope.
label_definitions.external_review_needed: Area is candidate for the next external review cycle. NOT a positive claim; forward-looking only.
label_definitions.not_applicable: The area does not apply to the current scope.

labels_disallowed_in_this_heatmap: any label that implies external validation, lender approval, certification, or audit approval

claude_review_status.rationale: Claude review is handled separately outside the B-track governance pack. global_notes: All labels are project-internal self-assessments. They are not externally validated, not customer-facing, and do not authorize any external claim.

Reaching a high_internal_confidence label does not relax any no-go claim. The no-go list is governed separately (see docs/external_review/no_go_claims.md and docs/commercial/no_go_claims_commercial_guardrail.md).
The heatmap is a management-level roll-up, not a replacement for the B3 matrix. The B3 matrix is the authoritative evidence inventory.
The heatmap uses conservative labels that do not imply bankability, certification, audit approval, or external validation.
Updates to the heatmap are normal B-track work and follow the procedure in model_confidence_heatmap.md §6.

Claude review is separate. The B-track governance pack does not represent Claude review as completed. Phase 51N includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is handled outside this branch and is reflected in B16 (External Review Closeout Tracker) only as a separate workstream.
